meta.about: Negated search phrases (S12-017): 'X not Y Z' excludes only the negated words and never swallows a place. Built corpus-first for wave 4 fix 3: every label is written from the query's structure (which words were negated, which name a place, which stay wanted), never from a version's code; ambiguous cases are labelled on the safe side (one negated word) and marked. Queries are constructed from common job titles, the negations people use for them, and real place names, plus every input from both wave 4 rechecks and the round-1/round-2 tests, verbatim. No personal data.
meta.fields: expect is the right {positive, excluded}; alsoAccept lists answers that search the same; main is origin/main's output and mainCorrect/fa66a031Correct/r9af3c783Correct are each version's verdict; gap (when present) says why fix 3 still answers wrongly, gapAnswer is that answer (pinned, so a change shows), and gapAnswerIsMain says whether it is main's own answer. Every gap case is wrong on main too.
